elements.text: Overture prepares every application. It sends only when you approve.
It matches Postings to your Targets, fills each application from your Facts and resume, and shows every answer before anything is sent.
Verify a card to start. The trial is 3 applications, once per card.
Overture reads each posting's own form and fills it. No other system is supported yet.
Roles, locations, workplaces and the salary floor you want. Overture matches Postings against them.
Each Application is prepared with every answer, the resume and a cover letter where one is asked. You see the source of every answer.
Send goes out in daytime hours, 08:00 to 20:00 your local time, at least 20 minutes apart. Undo until sending starts.
Each application moves across the Board
The Board shows where every application stands with the employer, from Queued to Closed.
Being prepared, or waiting on a Review.
Sent to the employer, and confirmed.

An Application that can't be sent, or whose sending can't be confirmed, is marked Couldn't apply and never uses one of your applications. Only an Application confirmed sent counts against your plan. A
